notes: GR4 compiles debugging lines 'as specified in this presentation', and its own cross-reference (page VI-141) is VI.7.3, which permits a debugging line only after the OBJECT-COMPUTER paragraph. VI.7.3 has no catalog row of its own, so its placement rule is reached through this row. Under the mode, a D line carrying a DATE-WRITTEN paragraph in the Identification Division compiles and the program runs (p08). Where debugging lines are permitted they compile and run, as the read showed. The dual-syntax 'must' (refuter's d6/d7) is a second unenforced requirement that I did not re-probe. kb/Work PB5212 holds the defect (code read: held-85/set2/decisions.json).

(the format has no WITH DEBUGGING MODE clause)". The 2023 SOURCE-COMPUTER format keeps only computer-name-1, so the WITH DEBUGGING MODE clause is gone.
